The modern callback's stable native identity is exactly a seven-character lowercase-hex prefix of _hash; title-only, numeric, full-hash, wrong-width, uppercase, or otherwise non-native id shapes refuse rather than falling back to mutable titles or unrelated posts.

Only the reviewed current/legacy property schemas and explicitly classified native residue are admitted; unknown Contact Form 7 or add-on postmeta remains unclassified and loud rather than being guessed authored, runtime, or environment state.

The mixed wpcf7 settings blob and optional integration properties contain installed-version, validation, admin, and credential-bearing target state; they remain environment-owned and are verified to survive apply instead of crossing environments.
